root_cause: The aria-activedescendant attribute on the input was set to the item's data-value (store name) instead of the item's ID, causing assistive technologies to receive an incorrect reference.
repair_strategy: Modify the navigation controller's update function to set aria-activedescendant to the active list item's ID (list[currentFocus].id) rather than its dataset.value.
expected_accessibility_effect: Arrow navigation will now correctly expose the active option via aria-activedescendant, enabling screen readers to announce the highlighted suggestion as intended.
functional_risks: Any custom code that relied on aria-activedescendant containing the store name would need adjustment, but the specification and existing onSelection handler use the item's ID and data-feedback selection, so impact is minimal.
verification_requirements: After typing 'ma' and pressing ArrowDown once, aria-activedescendant on #store must equal 'autoCompleteJS_result_0'.
After a second ArrowDown, aria-activedescendant must equal 'autoCompleteJS_result_1'.
Pressing Enter must submit the correct store value ('Marina Park') into the form.
The regression guard for ArrowUp from the field to the last suggestion must continue to function.
